title: Coding Agent Memory Benchmark: LongMemEval-S, LoCoMo, and 19,195-Session Day-Zero Evaluation
description:
Reproducible evaluation artifacts, summary tables, and standalone Python scoring scripts for local AI coding-agent memory and session search tools.

  • LongMemEval-S: 470 cleaned questions (88.9% hit@1, 97.4% hit@5, 0.926 MRR) and 500 full questions (88.2% hit@1, 97.2% hit@5, 0.921 MRR), run with deja-vu 0.23.2 without LLM query rewriting or embeddings.
  • LoCoMo (retrieval-only metrics): 1,982 questions (71.9% hit@1, 91.4% hit@5, 0.802 MRR); reports retrieval metrics only and redistributes no upstream CC-BY-NC-4.0 dialogue text.
  • Day-Zero Cold Start (19,195 sessions on disk): head-to-head comparison of seven tools (deja-vu, ctx, CASS, agentsview, agentmemory, MemPalace, claude-mem) covering index build time, search latency, hit@k, and standing MCP tools/list schema overhead (measured against deja-vu 0.23.2 / commit 9906e203).
  • Task-Cost & Compaction Ablations: 11-run alternating repository tasks (commit 54f6f6ab), multi-session context readiness chains, and 43 real context compactions.
